description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenClawChatViewModel component in a Swift project. It defines helper functions to create test data, a mock transport class to simulate server communication, and multiple test cases to verify the behavior of chat session handling, message streaming, model selection, session management, and event handling within the chat application.

classes.name: CallbackBox
classes.description: A thread-safe container for accumulating callback values during tests.

classes.name: AsyncGate
classes.description: An actor used to synchronize asynchronous test steps, simulating delays.

classes.name: AsyncCounter
classes.description: An actor that provides thread-safe incrementing of a counter for test purposes.

classes.name: TestChatTransportState
classes.description: Internal state holder for tracking calls and messages sent via the test transport.

classes.name: TestChatTransport
classes.description: A mock implementation of OpenClawChatTransport simulating server interactions for tests.

methods.name: streamsAssistantAndClearsOnFinal
methods.description: Tests that the assistant message streaming appears and clears appropriately after a final event.

methods.name: keepsOptimisticUserMessageWhenFinalRefreshReturnsOnlyAssistantHistory
methods.description: Verifies that user messages are preserved during partial history refresh.

methods.name: keepsOptimisticUserMessageWhenFinalRefreshHistoryIsTemporarilyEmpty
methods.description: Ensures user messages remain visible even if history response is temporarily empty.

methods.name: doesNotDuplicateUserMessageWhenRefreshReturnsCanonicalTimestamp
methods.description: Checks that user messages are not duplicated when history refresh returns messages with the same timestamp.

methods.name: preservesRepeatedOptimisticUserMessagesWithIdenticalContentDuringRefresh
methods.description: Verifies repeated user messages with same content are maintained during history refresh.

methods.name: acceptsCanonicalSessionKeyEventsForOwnPendingRun
methods.description: Tests acceptance of external events matching the current session key for pending runs.

methods.name: acceptsCanonicalSessionKeyEventsForExternalRuns
methods.description: Checks handling of external run events for sessions not owned by the current process.

methods.name: preservesMessageIDsAcrossHistoryRefreshes
methods.description: Ensures message IDs do not change across history reloads, preserving message continuity.

methods.name: clearsStreamingOnExternalFinalEvent
methods.description: Verifies that streaming states are reset when an external final event is received.

methods.name: seqGapClearsPendingRunsAndAutoRefreshesHistory
methods.description: Tests that sequence gaps clear pending runs and trigger history refresh.

methods.name: sessionChoicesPreferMainAndRecent
methods.description: Verifies session choices ordering, prioritizing 'main' and recent sessions.

methods.name: sessionChoicesIncludeCurrentWhenMissing
methods.description: Ensures current session is included in choices even if missing from server list.

methods.name: sessionChoicesUseResolvedMainSessionKeyInsteadOfLiteralMain
methods.description: Checks that session key resolution uses the configured main session key.

methods.name: sessionChoicesHideInternalOnboardingSession
methods.description: Removes internal onboarding sessions from session choices.

methods.name: resetTriggerResetsSessionAndReloadsHistory
methods.description: Tests that resetting the session reinitiates history load and clears previous messages.

methods.name: compactTriggerCompactsSessionAndReloadsHistory
methods.description: Verifies compaction triggers session consolidation and reloads history.

methods.name: compactTriggerShowsGenericErrorMessageOnFailure
methods.description: Ensures user is notified if session compaction fails.

methods.name: compactTriggerIgnoresConcurrentAndImmediateRepeatRequests
methods.description: Prevents multiple concurrent compact requests and handles rapid retries gracefully.

methods.name: compactTriggerAllowsImmediateRetryAfterFailure
methods.description: Tests that user can retry session compaction immediately after a failure.

methods.name: bootstrapsModelSelectionFromSessionAndDefaults
methods.description: Verifies model selection defaults from session data and configuration.

methods.name: selectingDefaultModelPatchesNilAndUpdatesSelection
methods.description: Checks that selecting the default model updates the session accordingly.

methods.name: selectingProviderQualifiedModelDisambiguatesDuplicateModelIDs
methods.description: Ensures models with same ID but different providers are correctly distinguished.

methods.name: slashModelIDsStayProviderQualifiedInSelectionAndPatch
methods.description: Verifies that model IDs with provider qualifiers are preserved during patching.

methods.name: staleModelPatchCompletionsDoNotOverwriteNewerSelection
methods.description: Ensures outdated model patches do not override more recent user selections.

methods.name: failedLatestModelSelectionDoesNotReplayAfterOlderCompletionFinishes
methods.description: Verifies that failed model patches do not cause reversion to previous valid models after newer patches.

methods.name: failedLatestModelSelectionRestoresEarlierSuccessWithoutReplay
methods.description: Ensures that a failed patch does not undo previously successful model selections.

methods.name: switchingSessionsIgnoresLateModelPatchCompletionFromPreviousSession
methods.description: Checks that late model patch responses do not alter current session models.

methods.name: lateModelCompletionDoesNotReplayCurrentSessionSelectionIntoPreviousSession
methods.description: Verifies the isolation of model patch effects across session switches.

methods.name: explicitThinkingLevelWinsOverHistoryAndPersistsChanges
methods.description: Tests user-initiated thinking level updates override history and persist.

methods.name: serverProvidedThinkingLevelsOutsideMenuArePreservedForSend
methods.description: Verifies that server-set thinking levels outside menu are used for message sending.

methods.name: staleThinkingPatchCompletionReappliesLatestSelection
methods.description: Ensures outdated thinking level patches do not override latest user selection.

methods.name: clearsStreamingOnExternalErrorEvent
methods.description: Verifies streaming is stopped when an external error event occurs.

methods.name: stripsInboundMetadataFromHistoryMessages
methods.description: Ensures metadata is cleaned from inbound history messages, maintaining privacy.

methods.name: abortRequestsDoNotClearPendingUntilAbortedEvent
methods.description: Tests that pending request states are retained until an explicit aborted event is received.
